name: Cloud 80
notes: Domain-warped cloud: a soft cumulus spectrum resampled through low-frequency displacement - advected billows with silky streaming edges. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/cloud.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Overcast with breaks.
